name: An Alarming Request
summary: In Southshore, Emissary Jacques warns that Dalaran is in danger. Its ley lines are disrupted, and its constructs have turned erratic and destructive. Archmage Modera sent Jacques to seek outside aid. You are to find her image beside Lordamere Lake, near Dalaran.

sections.title: Trouble in Dalaran
sections.body:
Emissary Jacques brings troubling news from Dalaran. The city's ley lines are disrupted, and its constructs have turned erratic and destructive. No one knows why.

The high council ordered the matter kept private to spare the order shame. But Jacques says the charade cannot last while the city is being overrun. Archmage Modera sent him to seek outside aid. You are to find her image beside Lordamere Lake, near Dalaran.

sections.title: Modera's Welcome
sections.body: Archmage Modera's image greets you with word that Jacques found aid. Though the rules forbid it, pride must not turn allies away in the city's desperate hour. The guards may claim otherwise, but the danger is far from under control.

faq.answer: Emissary Jacques represents Dalaran in Southshore. Archmage Modera sent Jacques to seek outside aid.
Dalaran's ley lines are disrupted, and its constructs have turned erratic and destructive. The cause is unknown, and the city is being overrun.

faq.q: Why is the matter being kept private?
faq.answer: The high council ordered the trouble kept private to spare the order shame.

faq.q: Where is the Image of Archmage Modera located?
faq.answer: You can find the Image of Archmage Modera beside Lordamere Lake, near Dalaran.
